Back a controlled first test.

Help FPL managers make one useful transfer decision, then give them a reason to return.

Our ambition is 1,000 new returning users in 30 days. The account setup and saved work are verified. Acquisition performance and willingness to pay still need evidence.

When a larger budget makes sense

Leadership may increase the starting budget if the plan and likely outcomes justify it. Present the proposed extra spend, a realistic range of additional returning users, the evidence behind the cost assumptions, and the people/time needed to deliver.

Use the first tests to strengthen this case. As a planning calculation, extra budget divided by an evidenced cost per returning user gives a starting estimate; allow for costs changing at larger scale and whether people can return before the deadline. This is a scenario, not a promised result. Until leadership approves an increase, the £1,000 allocation and current channel limits apply.

One advertising test

Meta runs for six days at up to £25/day and £150 total. Aim for completed registrations, then measure useful use and return.

One suitable creator

Check recent relevant views, UK audience evidence and meaningful replies. Agree disclosure, timing, an identifiable link and demonstration reuse. If no suitable placement fits £125, keep the money.

Useful unpaid activity

Two X posts weekly and personal participation in one FPL community through its permitted route. Reuse the demo; invite mini-league sharing after a useful result. Five creator prospects are researched.

Earn the next test

Review each paid channel separately after the test ends and users have a fair return opportunity, including the next relevant gameweek. Continue only if either rule passes:

  1. The cost supports the user goal. Observed cost per returning user is no higher than remaining unspent and uncommitted campaign money divided by returning users still needed.
  2. Actual sales cover that test. Purchase money after refunds, payment charges and a reasonable membership-service allowance covers acquisition spending. Unknown service costs cannot pass this check.

If neither passes: pause, fix the biggest problem and report the gap.

Pause immediately for broken signup, unreliable counting or incorrect claims. Each release is another capped test. A Meta result does not automatically release creator money.

£1,000 / 1,000 = £1 per returning user overall. This is budget arithmetic, not a benchmark. Higher paid costs need enough additional users from unpaid activity to support the goal. The full starting budget need not be spent. Any increase requires a new leadership decision; revenue alone does not authorise it.

Fix the free-access mismatch before promotion

The live homepage checked on 5 September still said 30 September. The approved free premium end is 20 October 2026, with Guest/Free access afterwards and no automatic charge. Change the real access rules and all wording before advertising the new date.

Promote available features. Keep coming-soon labels and introduce PL Predictor only after Gameweek 6 and a readiness check.

Learn what users will pay.

The future model is subscription. The soft launch uses one optional founding offer to test willingness to pay, with the free period fully preserved.

Proposed founding offer

£29

One payment. No automatic renewal.

Premium access: 21 October 2026 - 31 May 2027. All premium features available during that season, with no add-on fees.

Offer window: 21 September - 20 October, only after meaningful use across two gameweeks and after payment, access and refund checks pass.

Confirm membership access within one working day after checking payment.

Five short conversations

Five unpaid, 20-minute interviews with returning and stopped users. Ask what decision they faced, what helped and what would justify paying. Use actual behaviour alongside their views.

Report purchases, refusals, reasons and money after costs. No purchases while access is free is inconclusive. This month cannot establish an optimal monthly price or prove renewals. Purchases after 6 October are reported separately.

Planning allowance: ten team hours weekly

Bola’s hours, consulting fee and execution fee must be agreed separately with FPL leadership. These are outside the marketing campaign spend budget. The ten-hour figure is a combined team planning allowance; it does not establish Bola’s individual hours or fees.

The weekly leadership checkpoint

Spend and commitments. Registrations and useful first uses. Different-day returners. Purchases and costs. Gap to 1,000. One next decision.

Show the numbers behind percentages. Mark users without a fair return opportunity “too early to judge”; label missing measurement clearly. Decide to continue, change or pause from observed evidence.
